PP_StartIntro: How PhantomPad opens and what closing the window does. Each option has its own switch to turn it on or off.
PP_StartWithWindowsText: Opens by itself when the PC turns on.
PP_StartHiddenText: When it opens no window appears, only the ghost icon next to the clock. Click the icon to see it.
PP_StartCloseTray: When closing the window, keep it in the tray
PP_StartCloseTrayText: The X hides the window and PhantomPad keeps working, without asking. To quit completely: right-click the icon → Exit.
PP_StartAutoConnectText: When PhantomPad opens, controllers that are on are ready to play without pressing "Start". If you turn it off, you will have to press "Start" every time.
PP_StartTip: With all four options on: turn on the PC and the controller, and you are ready to play.
